bundle.shortDescription: Find what's using a port and stop it.
bundle.longDescription: portiye shows every listening port on your machine, which process owns it, and which project that process was started from — then lets you stop it in one click, taking its child processes with it. A graphical answer to lsof -i, netstat -ano and EADDRINUSE. It also manages the Android emulators, iOS simulators, Docker containers, Ollama models and JVM build daemons that opened half of those ports. Lives in the menu bar; no telemetry, no account, no network calls. macOS, Linux and Windows, in 28 languages.
